import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} (shape={df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string())
    print()

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx')
print("Columns:", list(df.columns))
print(df.to_string())

import sys
import pandas as pd

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'budget.xlsx'
sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None)
grand = 0.0
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} | shape={df.shape} ===")
    print("Columns:", list(df.columns))
    print(df.to_string())
    nums = df.select_dtypes(include='number')
    if not nums.empty:
        print("Column totals:", nums.sum().to_dict())
        grand += float(nums.to_numpy().sum())
    print()
print(f"GRAND TOTAL (all numeric cells): {grand}")
